verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming app. A product of this kind could plausibly expose a programmatic API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no public API, no API versioning and no deprecation policy, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. App release notifications and Homebrew upgrades concern app versions, not versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
